name: com.darsh.multipleimageselect.activities.AlbumSelectActivity
description: CrazyCodeBoy MultipleImageSelect is a photo-picker SDK, also published as a WDEO3601-maintained fork. This screen opens when an app asks the user to choose photos, lists albums from the device photo library, and opens the selected album.
disableEffect: Apps that use this picker can no longer browse photo albums or continue to selecting photos through this screen.
